items.title: Radial gradient and Laplacian from a local scalar profile

source.scope: Local C2 scalar-profile gradient and trace formulas in finite real Hilbert spaces.
source.label: ASTIS sealed radial-calculus specification

items.statement: A locally C2 scalar function of squared distance has explicit gradient and Laplacian in every finite real Hilbert space. For all E,g,a,x under precisely the stated local conditions, both displayed derivative identities hold.
assumptions: \(E\) is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, with its induced norm and inner product; dimension zero is allowed.
\(g:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R\), \(a,x\in E\), and \(g\) is \(C^2\) at \(S=\|x-a\|^2\). No global regularity or condition \(x\ne a\) is imposed.
\(g\) may be arbitrary outside a neighborhood of \(S\). Both gradient and Laplacian are actual derivatives; the latter is the orthonormal trace of the second Fréchet derivative.

formulae.label: Radial gradient and Laplacian from a local scalar profile
formulae.tex: S=\|x-a\|^2,\quad d=\dim E,\qquad\nabla(g\circ S)(x)=2g\prime(S)(x-a),\quad\Delta(g\circ S)(x)=4Sg\prime\prime(S)+2d g\prime(S).

obligations.label: A locally C2 scalar function of squared distance has explicit gradient and Laplacian in every finite real Hilbert space.

items.statement: The source power/log test functions are harmonic away from the origin, and their values and outward radial derivatives are explicit on every positive sphere. For every natural n>=2, the literal piecewise function has the stated harmonicity and all positive-radius boundary data.
assumptions: \(n\) is a natural number with \(n\ge2\), the source standing real Euclidean dimension. All subtractions in the real exponents are real subtraction.
\(F(x)=\log\|x\|\) for \(n=2\); \(F(x)=\|x\|^{2-n}\) for \(n>2\). Harmonicity is asserted on the entire complement of the origin, with no claim at the pole.
For the boundary conclusion, \(R>0\) and \(\|x\|=R\). The vector is explicitly \(R^{-1}x\); identifying it with a geometric ball/annulus normal is separate.
Actual local C2 regularity and all derivative formulas are proved internally, with no harmonicity, gradient, Laplacian or Green-identity premise.
